Monson Lodge and multiple base camps—North Slope, Trail Head, Frontier, Tomahawk, Pinnacle, Riverview, and Ridgeline—serving weeklong youth-group camping.

name: Camp Bowman
summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp at Goshen Scout Reservation, featuring patrol-cooking.

name: Camp Marriott
summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp at Goshen Scout Reservation in Goshen, Virginia, featuring an extensive aquatics program.

name: Camp Ottari
summary: Scouts BSA resident camp at Blue Ridge Scout Reservation in the Blue Ridge Mountains, offering traditional tent campsites, more than 30 merit badges, and the Mile Swim.

name: Camp PMI
summary: Webelos resident camp located at Goshen Scout Reservation in Goshen, Virginia.

name: Camp Powhatan
summary: Scouts BSA resident camp at Blue Ridge Scout Reservation in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Hiwassee, Virginia, operated by Blue Ridge Mountains Council.

name: Camp Rock Enon
summary: Shenandoah Area Council Cub Scout and Webelos resident summer camp offering rank Adventures, aquatics, climbing, and range and target sports.

name: Camp T. Brady Saunders
summary: Heart of Virginia Council's Scouts BSA long-term resident summer camp in Maidens, Virginia.

name: Camp William B. Snyder
summary: National Capital Area Council camp in Haymarket, Virginia, designed for Cub Scouts, offering Cub and Webelos resident programs, Cub day sessions, and Scouts BSA specialty programming.

name: Claytor Lake Aquatics Base
summary: High-adventure aquatics base on Claytor Lake in Virginia, operated by the Blue Ridge Mountains Council as part of the Blue Ridge Scout Reservation.

name: Cub and Webelos Adventure Camp
summary: Cub Scout resident camp operated by the Heart of Virginia Council at the Heart of Virginia Scout Reservation in Maidens, Virginia.

name: Lenhok'sin High Adventure
summary: High-adventure base at Goshen Scout Reservation in Goshen, Virginia, offering backpacking and canoe treks on the James River for older Scouts.

name: Camp Black Mountain
summary: Property retained for weekend and off-season use; no resident summer camp is offered.

name: Camp Bonaparte
summary: Cub Scout and Scouts BSA resident camp on Bonaparte Lake in Washington's Colville National Forest, offering archery, BB guns, swimming, boating, and a climbing wall.

name: Camp Edward
summary: Cub Scout resident camp offering the Buckaroo Round-Up program for Wolf, Bear, and Webelos Scouts, operated by the Chief Seattle Council near Snohomish, Washington.

name: Camp Parsons
summary: Historic Hood Canal resident camp at the foot of the Olympic Mountains, offering sailing, kayaking, and mountain treks. Facilities include a waterfront, dining hall, shooting sports, and climbing, plus an older Scout program and high-adventure options.

name: Camp Pigott
summary: Chief Seattle Council Scouts BSA resident summer camp located near Monroe and Snohomish, Washington.

name: Camp Sheppard
summary: Cascade forest resident camp bordering Mt. Rainier National Forest, offering hiking and ecology programs alongside a dining hall, shooting sports, climbing, COPE, and STEM activities.

name: Camp Thunderbird
summary: Cub Scout resident summer camp of Pacific Harbors Council, set on Summit Lake west of Olympia, Washington, serving Cub Scouts in early elementary grades.

name: Cowles Scout Reservation (Cub Scout Overnight Camp)
summary: Inland Northwest Council Cub Scout overnight and resident camp on Diamond Lake in Newport, Washington.

name: Fire Mountain Scout Camp
summary: Resident camp in the North Cascades foothills near Mount Vernon, Washington, featuring a strong first-year program and mountain biking trails, plus a dining hall, waterfront, shooting sports, climbing, COPE, and STEM offerings.

name: Scout-A-Vista
summary: Alpine Cub Scout day camp operated by Chief Seattle Council (Grand Columbia) near Wenatchee, Washington, located northeast of Mission Ridge Ski Resort.

name: Akela's World Cub Scout Camp
summary: Cub Scout weekend resident camp at Crystal Lake Scout Reservation near Rhinelander, Wisconsin, operated by Samoset Council for Cub Scout packs with high-energy activities.

name: Camp Decorah
summary: Council-operated Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Holmen, Wisconsin, offering a multi-night stay.

name: Camp Oh-Da-Ko-Ta
summary: Cub Scout day camp on 185 acres with waterfront on Dyer Lake near Burlington, offering boating, swimming, fishing, field sports, nature, and shooting sports. Serves as a certified Cub Scout day camp and family camping facility.

name: Camp Rokilio
summary: Cub Scout resident camp on 213 acres in the Kettle Moraine near Kiel, with lodging in four themed buildings. Offers waterfront, shooting sports, nature, and STEM/NOVA programming for Tigers through Webelos.

name: Ed Bryant Scout Reservation
summary: Glacier's Edge Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp spanning 244 acres along Castle Rock Lake near Mauston, Wisconsin, offering boating, jet skiing, ATVs, and a range of merit badges.

name: Gardner Dam Adventure Base
summary: Bay-Lakes Council Scouts BSA and Venturing adventure resident camp on 400 acres along the Wild Wolf River in Langlade County, Wisconsin, featuring whitewater kayaking and rafting, COPE and climbing, ATVing, mountain biking, and merit badges.

name: Hanna Venture Base
summary: High-adventure base within Samoset Council's Crystal Lake Scout Reservation in Rhinelander, Wisconsin, offering week-long wilderness treks to the Apostle Islands and Porcupine Mountains for older Scouts and Venturers, with gear provided.

name: Tesomas Scout Camp
summary: Samoset Council's flagship Scouts BSA resident camp at Crystal Lake Scout Reservation near Rhinelander, Wisconsin, offering week-long periods with a wide range of merit badge opportunities.

name: Camp Arrowhead (General Andrew Lewis Scout Reservation)
summary: Buckskin Council's 280-acre summer camp in Ona, West Virginia, serving as the council's consolidated site for Scouts BSA and Cub Scout camping.

name: Camp Mountaineer
summary: Mountaineer Area Council's Scouts BSA resident camp spanning over 1,000 acres near Morgantown, West Virginia, offering a block program schedule with 50 merit badges.

name: James C. Justice National Scout Camp
summary: Scouts BSA and Venturing resident camp at the Summit Bechtel Reserve in West Virginia, offering more than 70 merit badges, the Brownsea first-year program, and access to high-adventure venues including whitewater, ziplining, BMX, and mountain biking.

name: Sandscrest Scout Reservation Cub Scout Day Camp
summary: Mountaineer Area Council Cub Scout day camp associated with Sandscrest Scout Reservation in Wheeling, West Virginia, serving youth entering grades one through five.

name: Camp Laramie Peak
summary: Scouts BSA resident camp of the Adventure West Council with family-style dining hall, set at the base of Black Mountain near Wheatland beside Medicine Bow National Forest. Offerings range from the Roaring Lion first-year program to high-adventure rock climbing, mountain boarding, and ATVs.

name: Camp Loll
summary: Wilderness Scouts BSA resident camp of the Crossroads of the West Council, set on Lake of the Woods in Teton County, Wyoming, near Yellowstone. Offers a classic camp program alongside high-adventure options and the A.C.E. program for older youth.

name: Teton High Adventure Base
summary: Nationally accredited high-adventure base south of Jackson Hole in Wyoming, offering whitewater rafting, kayaking, mountain biking, backpacking, and a rope course, with bunkhouse and tent lodging and a dining hall.
